key.name: magnification-tap
key.summary: Tap the screen several times to magnify
key.description: Tapping magnification-tap-count times toggles the zoom at the tapped point. While on, single taps reach apps about 0.3 s later (they could be the start of the gesture).

key.name: magnification-tap-count
key.summary: Number of taps that toggle magnification

key.name: magnification-hold
key.description: Tap one time less than the tap count, then keep the finger down: the screen is magnified until the finger is lifted, and moving the finger pans.

key.name: magnification-shortcut
key.summary: Hold both volume keys to toggle magnification

key.name: magnification-level
key.summary: Zoom level (pinching with two fingers while magnified changes it)

key.name: colour-inversion
key.summary: Colour inversion (light becomes dark, hues are kept)

key.name: colour-correction
key.summary: Colour correction: none, deuteranomaly (red-green), protanomaly (red-green), tritanomaly (blue-yellow) or greyscale

key.name: mono-audio
key.summary: Mono audio: play the same sound on both channels

key.name: audio-balance
key.summary: Left/right balance (-1 = left only, 0 = centre, 1 = right only)
